summary: Implemented pure crop/rotation math and an accessible react-easy-crop editor with rotation-aware aspect, keyboard nudges, reset, cancel, and normalized save; 49 targeted tests, full suite 379, typecheck, lint, formatting, and production build pass.

payload.agentOutputExcerpt: Implemented pure crop/rotation math and an accessible react-easy-crop editor with rotation-aware aspect, keyboard nudges, reset, cancel, and normalized save; 49 targeted tests, full suite 379, typecheck, lint, formatting, and production build pass.
decisions: Reset restores the crop and rotation the editor opened with: full/upright at import, stored crop on card detail.
The default frame aspect follows the initial crop and swaps for 90/270 turns unless the caller pins an aspect such as square.
clampCropRect preserves aspect ratio for arbitrary rectangles; normalizeCropRect mirrors the image pipeline's edge-clamping semantics.
The editor owns no persistence, object URL, pipeline, network, or storage side effects.
interfaces: CropRotateEditor({ imageSrc, sourceWidth, sourceHeight, initialCrop?, initialRotation?, aspect?, nudgeStep?, title?, imageAlt?, saveLabel?, onSave, onCancel })
onSave({ crop: { x, y, width, height }, rotation: 0 | 90 | 180 | 270 }) with a source-frame normalized crop

cropMath exports normalizeCropRect, clampCropRect, isCropContained, translateCropRect, nudgeCropRect, cropToRotated, cropFromRotated, computeOutputBounds, previewDimensions, rotatedAspectRatio, rotateLeft, rotateRight, rotateBy, rotatedDimensions, resetCropState, describeCrop, and cropRectsEqual

Component tests use a controllable react-easy-crop mock; real image measurement and touch feel remain for browser or human review.
Corner marks are visual handles; touch resizing uses the cropper's pan and pinch/scroll zoom rather than draggable corners.
validationLimitations: No real-browser or Playwright crop exercise was run because CAP-2 is not wired into a route; CAP-3/CAP-4 own that integration.
The editor's live summary updates during selection changes; screen-reader nudge and rotation paths were tested with keyboard events in jsdom.
payload.taskDescription: Implement cropMath.ts as pure helpers for normalized crop rectangles, 90-degree rotation, rotation-aware preview dimensions, containment, reset, and output bounds. Build CropRotateEditor.tsx on react-easy-crop with a dark mat, touch handles, rotate left/right, reset, cancel, and save. Expose rotation buttons and crop nudge controls for keyboard users, 44px targets, and an announced summary of the crop. Do not persist anything from this component.
